text:
sophia_ae: Heads-up 10xPayments wants a BYO-HSM POC with two unusual asks: (1) rotation proofs must be anchored to a public ledger (they mentioned Ethereum testnet) for immutability, (2) the HSMs live in their VPC but must host multiple tenant keyslots (separate key namespaces for sub-orgs). Need feasibility + pricing. cc @ashish_se @emily_security

ashish_se: Ledger anchoring is doable: we can produce a rotation proof digest and push a TX to a public testnet. Need to confirm they accept testnet vs mainnet (TX cost diff). Multi-tenant key namespaces depend on vendor; many HSMs support partitions or domains. Need exact model & vendor module. Network model: proxy in their VPC calling their HSMs over mTLS.

emily_security: Security concerns: public anchoring leaks rotation digests publicly (which they accepted), but we must ensure digest does not contain key material. We'll state firmly: digest = sha256(rotation_manifest) where manifest contains only metadata and signed proof, no plaintext. Also require attestation of partitioning feature. Blocker: some compliance teams don't allow public ledger anchoring; check their legal OK.

ron_sre: Perf note: anchoring TX latency not in critical path — we anchor async after rotation. For peak signing (they said 500 rps bursts), we should size proxy nodes accordingly. Multi-tenant isolation: we must ensure audit logs include tenant_id and we rotate each tenant's keys independently. We'll provide sample audit line.

sophia_ae: Procurement Q: will anchoring be billed per TX or as a flat add-on? They prefer predictable costs.

ashish_se: Recommend: POC flat fee includes N testnet TXs (e.g., 10). Production: option A) monthly anchoring bundle (X TXs), option B) per-TX microfee. Also BYO-HSM premium + reserved throughput tier. Note: mainnet anchoring has variable gas cost; we should bill pass-through or hedge with pre-paid bucket.

emily_security: For SOW we must include runbook items: vendor PKCS#11/KMIP, partition docs (how tenant namespaces enforced), attestation, rotation cadence (they asked 14 days), anchor policy (which fields hashed), and sample notarized proof if they purchase auditor add-on. Example audit/anchor artifacts below.

ashish_se: Sample POC curl to sign and then anchor proof (staging):

```
curl -X POST https://staging-proxy.redwood.local/sign -H 'Authorization: Bearer POCTOKEN' -d '{"tenant":"subacct-42","key_id":"10x-pay-rot-1","payload":"..."}'
# returns signature and rotation_manifest_id
curl -X POST https://staging-proxy.redwood.local/anchor -H 'Authorization: Bearer POCTOKEN' -d '{"manifest_id":"rot-manifest-123"}'
```

ron_sre: Example manifest we will hash (we never include key material):

"manifest_id:rot-manifest-123; key_id:10x-pay-rot-1; tenant:subacct-42; rotated_at:2026-09-02T14:00:00Z; rotated_by=customer; audit_sig=rsa:BASE64SIG"

ops_bot: staging-proxy deployed to customer-vpc-proxy at 2026-09-01T18:11Z

emily_security: Example audit + anchor entry for runbook: 

"2026-09-02T14:00:05Z INFO rotation tenant=subacct-42 key=10x-pay-rot-1 manifest_id=rot-manifest-123 proof_hash=sha256:aa11bb tx_hash=0x5f3abc... ledger=goerli notarized=false"

sophia_ae: Customer legal OK'd testnet anchoring for POC. They still want a quote showing both testnet bundle and mainnet pass-through. Also asked we show sample CI rules to prevent key leaks.

ashish_se: Action items: (1) get vendor partition docs and PKCS#11 .so, (2) size nodes for 500 rps bursts, (3) draft SOW with anchoring pricing buckets, (4) security to draft runbook and CI grep rules.

emily_security: I'll draft security Q&A + runbook snippet and include the manifest/hash template and sample grep rules.

sophia_ae: Thanks team 64f I'll send vendor ask to customer and follow up on pricing preference.
